messages:
marta: quick follow-up from the missing-spans postmortem 3 scheduling a short checkpoint to confirm remediations and owners. recap: missing spans due to sampler config drift, aggregator double-count for ~0.7% of traces, ETL lag spikes during midnight window. who can confirm ownership for each remediation?

dom: I can own sampler config drift. plan: pin sampler config in helm values, add admission webhook validation, and add e2e test. ETA next Tue for PR.

lee: taking aggregator correction. adding invariant checks + nightly sanity job to detect duplicate counts. target end of week for initial rollout.

sylvia: I'll own the ETL lag follow-up 3 investigating shard imbalance and backpressure in the kafka consumer. small mitigation (consumer parallelism bump) deployed today, deeper fix next sprint.

jordan: +1 on owners. please create tracked tickets so we can report progress in the postmortem thread.

marta: yes 3 create tickets in the observability board and tag PM:analytics and label:postmortem-fix. follow-up meeting Thu 14:00 PT to check blockers.

dom: created OBS-1499 for sampler pin + webhook. desc: "Pin sampler config in helm values, add admission validation, e2e test to prevent drift" link: https://issues.internal/OBS-1499 :thumbsup:

lee: created OBS-1500 for aggregator checks + nightly job. owner: lee; reviewers: dom, sylvia. added checklist for test vectors.

sylvia: created OBS-1501 for ETL shard rebalance experiment and consumer tuning. step 0: mitigation already in prod.

oncall-bot: Reminder: incident runbook snapshot saved at 2407129800. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/observability-missing-spans

jordan: propose a metric "spans_lost_rate" + alert if >0.1% over 15m. that'll catch regressions early.

marta: agreed. dom, can you add the metric query and alert in OBS-1499?

dom: yes. will add metric, grafana panel, and a low-severity pager rule. posting query here once ready.

lee: note from local runs: found bucket TTL edge-case causing duplicate counting. adding mitigation to OBS-1500 and a unit test snippet.

marta: tracking: update ticket status by Wed EOD. escalate blockers in this thread.

sylvia: mitigation deployed (consumer parallelism bump + rebalance). monitoring logs now; will report back in 20m.

oncall-bot: deploy started by sylvia at 2407130100. Command: ```kubectl -n analytics rollout restart deploy etl-consumer```

lee: CI plan 3 synthetic trace generator to catch aggregation drift in PR checks. snippet: ```python
# synthetic trace generator
for i in range(2000):
    send_trace(sampled=True, spans=rand_spans())
```

jordan: if nightly sanity job and new alert pass for 3 days, we can close the follow-up and fold into standard monitoring. propose review 3 business days after fixes merged.

marta: understood. calendar invite sent for Thu 14:00 PT. agenda: status, blockers, close criteria. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
